full_prompt_en: A square retro vector-like illustration layers a camper and a compact mountain town beneath an enormous circular golden sun, all against a nearly black sky. The upper center holds the sun as nested amber, orange and rust rings around a small dark core. Thin curved lines repeat beyond its rim, so the glow reads as a graphic pattern rather than soft photographic light. Flat pale cloud bands enter from both upper sides, and a smaller orange disk hangs near the upper-right edge. Across the middle distance, cream-colored mountain peaks rise in sharp angular planes. A second set of muted blue and ochre arcs sits to the left, while blocky buildings in mustard, red, teal and charcoal overlap the mountains below. Their windows are reduced to short dark rectangles. Pointed conifer silhouettes stand between the facades, alternating dark blue green and warm red orange. The foreground is anchored by a cream and brick-red camper placed just right of center. Its rounded roof and rectangular side panels carry a few small windows and crisp black seams, while its two circular wheels rest on a narrow horizontal road. Much smaller vehicles sit near the left and right edges, reinforcing the difference in scale without drawing attention away from the central camper. A thick ochre strip and a terracotta embankment separate the road from the water along the lower edge. Beneath them, the water is built from horizontal blue, teal and pale gold bars with a small warm reflection near the center. Dark triangular forms crop into the bottom corners and echo the pointed trees above. The image uses hard-edged shapes, limited flat color, closely packed decorative lines and a subtly worn print surface. Light is expressed by the pale mountain planes, the large warm disk and narrow gold accents rather than by continuous shading; the black gaps keep every bright area distinct. The overall composition stacks circular sky, jagged mountains, rectilinear town and horizontal water into a dense but orderly travel image in warm ochre and deep teal.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形的复古矢量感插画在近黑色天空下层叠一辆露营车与紧凑的山间小镇，上方是巨大的金色圆形太阳。画面上方中央，太阳由嵌套的琥珀、橙色和锈红色圆环围绕一个小暗芯构成。细弧线在外圈重复，使光晕像图形纹样，而非柔和的摄影光。平涂的浅色云带从上方两侧伸入，右上边缘附近还悬着一枚较小的橙色圆盘。中景中，奶油色山峰以尖锐的角面抬升。左侧还有一组低饱和蓝色与赭色弧形，下方芥黄、红、青绿和炭黑色的块状建筑在山前交叠。窗户被简化为短小的深色矩形。尖形针叶树剪影插在立面之间，深蓝绿色与暖红橙色交替。前景由一辆略偏右的奶油白与砖红色露营车稳定下来。圆润的车顶、矩形侧板上只有几扇小窗与清晰黑色接缝，两只圆轮落在狭窄的水平道路上。更小的车辆位于左右边缘，强化尺度差异，却不抢中央露营车的注意力。厚赭黄色带与赤陶色堤岸把道路和下缘水面分开。其下水面由水平蓝色、青绿和浅金色条带构成，中央附近有一点暖色反光。深色三角形从底部两角切入，呼应上方的尖树。图像采用硬边形体、有限的平涂色彩、紧密的装饰线条和略带磨损的印刷表面。光由浅色山体平面、巨大的暖色圆盘及窄金色亮点表现，而非连续明暗塑形；黑色间隙让每个亮区保持分明。整体构图把圆形天空、锯齿山脉、矩形小镇与水平水面叠成密集而有序的旅行图景，以暖赭色和深青绿统领画面。
style_prompt_en: The image has a retro graphic print finish built from flat, hard-edged geometric shapes and densely nested line patterns. Broad areas of near black provide a base for warm ochre, burnt orange and brick red, balanced by compact teal and blue green passages. Concentric curves, horizontal bars and sharp triangular accents repeat at different scales, turning the surface into an ordered rhythm. Small details appear as short marks, slots and seams rather than naturalistic modeling, while a faint worn grain softens the otherwise precise color boundaries. Illumination is conveyed through high contrast placement of pale cream and gold within dark fields; gradual shading remains limited. Shallow stacked layers and clear overlaps establish depth without giving up the poster-like flatness. The overall effect is bold and nostalgic, with disciplined color blocks and fine decorative lines sharing the frame.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有复古图形印刷的完成面，由平涂、硬边的几何形体与密集嵌套的线条纹样构成。大面积近黑色为暖赭黄、焦橙与砖红色提供底色，紧凑的青绿与蓝绿色区域与之平衡。同心曲线、水平条带和尖锐三角强调在不同尺度上重复，把画面表面组织为有秩序的节奏。小细节以短笔痕、窄槽和接缝出现，而非写实塑形；轻微磨损颗粒又使原本精确的色块边界略微柔和。光通过深色区域中浅奶油色和金色的高反差位置来表达，渐变塑形很少。浅层叠置和清晰遮挡建立纵深，同时保留海报式平面感。整体效果鲜明且怀旧，严格组织的色块与细密装饰线条共同占据画面。
theme_en: A geometric retro travel illustration with a camper, mountain town, circular sun and water
theme_zh: 带有露营车、山间小镇、圆形太阳与水面的几何复古旅行插画
name: Aaron James Draplin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
